query: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.id = ? AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM blocks b WHERE (b.blocker_id = ? AND b.blocked_id = u.id) OR (b.blocker_id = u.id AND b.blocked_id = ?)))
